# Safi Ullah - SEO, GEO & AEO Specialist

> Abu Dhabi, UAE based freelance digital marketing consultant specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Google Ads, Meta Ads and web development.

## About
Safi Ullah is a Digital Marketing Specialist with 5+ years of experience across the UAE, Qatar and Pakistan. He helps businesses grow organic traffic, leads and revenue through search optimization for Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and voice assistants.

## Services
- SEO (On-page, Technical, Off-page, Local SEO)
- GEO - Generative Engine Optimization for AI search engines
- AEO - Answer Engine Optimization for featured snippets and voice
- Google Ads & Meta Ads management
- Web Development (WordPress, Shopify, custom)
- Technical SEO audits and Core Web Vitals optimization
- Schema markup and structured data
- Analytics (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)
